Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.service

Class ScenarioService

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.service.ScenarioService
public class ScenarioService extends Object
Creates temporary sustainability scenarios from current household data. Scenario changes remain in memory and do not update the household's persisted resource records. Saving a scenario (US-29) stores it in its own table, again without touching the household's resource records or history.
